rationale: The workflow runs two matrix jobs (`test` and `test-cross-platform`) with `fail-fast: false`, which structurally matches P-LIT-FAIL-FAST (cancel remaining matrix jobs after failure). However, that pattern's safety precondition requires verifying that remaining matrix results are dispensable and that no required-check contract mandates every outcome. The repository's required_checks status is `not_verified`, and the main `test` job runs every Node.js version with no `continue-on-error`, so I cannot rule out that every matrix outcome is required. Cancelling remaining jobs on a failure would reduce test coverage on failure, contradicting the requirement to preserve intended build/test coverage. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT's evidence comes from a different workflow with an unverified outcome and there is no evidence of runaway jobs in this repository's history, so adding a job timeout is not supported here. No optimization has verifiable preconditions met with contraindications ruled out while preserving coverage.
